content: Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of posaconazole by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir reduces the efficacy of pramlintide through mechanisms related to insulin resistance caused by protease inhibitors, potentially leading to hyperglycemia. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the toxicity of pravastatin by inhibiting OATP1B1 transporters, which may elevate the risk of myopathy. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of praziquantel by inhibiting hepatic and intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of prednisolone by inhibiting both hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism and the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of prednisone by inhibiting both hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism and the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Primidone decreases the concentration or effect of indinavir by inducing hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Quercetin decreases the concentration or effect of indinavir by inducing the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of quetiapine by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of quinidine by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases the concentration or effect of indinavir by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Ranolazine increases the concentration or effect of indinavir by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of repaglinide by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Ribociclib increases the concentration or effect of indinavir by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the levels of rifabutin by reducing its metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Rifampin decreases the concentration or effect of indinavir by inducing the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Rifapentine decreases the concentration or effect of indinavir by inducing hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the levels of rilpivirine by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of riociguat by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of ripretinib by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Co-administration with strong CYP3A inhibitors may increase systemic exposure to ripretinib and its active metabolite (DP-5439), raising the risk of adverse reactions. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of risperidone by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of ritonavir by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Ritonavir also increases the concentration or effect of indinavir by the same mechanism. Both drugs increase the risk of immune reconstitution syndrome. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of roflumilast by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of roflumilast topical by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir reduces the efficacy of rosiglitazone through mechanisms related to insulin resistance caused by protease inhibitors, potentially leading to hyperglycemia. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Rucaparib increases the concentration or effect of indinavir by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Adjust the dosage of CYP3A4 substrates if clinically indicated. Rufinamide decreases the concentration or effect of indinavir by inducing hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of sacubitril/valsartan by inhibiting OATP1B1 transporters, which may increase valsartan systemic exposure. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Sarecycline increases the concentration or effect of indinavir by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Monitor for toxicities of P-gp substrates that may require dosage reduction when co-administered with P-gp inhibitors. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of saxagliptin by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Limit saxagliptin to 5 mg/day when co-administered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. Indinavir increases the levels of seladelpar by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Use caution in patients who are poor CYP2C9 metabolizers and are co-administered a moderate/strong CYP3A4 inhibitor. Indinavir increases the levels of sertraline by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. There is potential for increased toxicity. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of sildenafil by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Patients receiving indinavir with ritonavir should not exceed 25 mg of sildenafil for erectile dysfunction within a 48-hour period. For other protease inhibitors, use a lower initial sildenafil dose of 25 mg. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of silodosin by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of sirolimus by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir reduces the efficacy of sitagliptin through mechanisms related to insulin resistance caused by protease inhibitors, potentially leading to hyperglycemia. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Sodium zirconium cyclosilicate decreases the concentration or effect of indinavir by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Administer drugs at least 2 hours before or after sodium zirconium cyclosilicate. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of sofosbuvir/velpatasvir by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of solifenacin by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of sorafenib by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. St. John’s Wort decreases the concentration or effect of indinavir by inducing the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Stiripentol increases the concentration or effect of indinavir by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Stiripentol is both a CYP3A4 inhibitor and inducer. Monitor CYP3A4 substrates co-administered with stiripentol for increased or decreased effects. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of stiripentol by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of streptomycin by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of sufentanil SL by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration with any CYP3A4 inhibitor may increase sufentanil plasma concentration, potentially leading to prolonged or severe adverse effects, including fatal respiratory depression. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of sunitinib by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of tacrolimus by inhibiting both hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism and the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of tacrolimus ointment by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of tasimelteon by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Tazemetostat decreases the concentration or effect of indinavir by inducing hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Tecovirimat decreases the concentration or effect of indinavir by inducing hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Tecovirimat is a weak CYP3A4 inducer. Monitor sensitive CYP3A4 substrates for effectiveness if co-administered. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of temsirolimus by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir and tenofovir DF both increase the risk of immune reconstitution syndrome. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of terbinafine by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of tezacaftor by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Adjust the tezacaftor dosage regimen if co-administered with a strong CYP3A inhibitor. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of theophylline by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the levels of ticagrelor by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid use with strong CYP3A inhibitors. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of tinidazole by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of tipranavir by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Both indinavir and tipranavir increase the risk of immune reconstitution syndrome. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the levels of tisotumab vedotin by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Its active metabolite (MMAE) is a CYP3A4 substrate. Co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase unconjugated MMAE systemic exposure and the risk of adverse effects. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of tobramycin by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of tolterodine by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of tolvaptan by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Tolvaptan also increases the concentration or effect of indinavir by the same mechanism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Topiramate decreases the concentration or effect of indinavir by inducing hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the levels of toremifene by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Metabolism of toremifene may be inhibited by drugs known to inhibit CYP3A4 hepatic enzymes. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the levels of tramadol by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. There is potential for increased toxicity. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of trazodone by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Trazodone decreases the concentration or effect of indinavir by inducing the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of triamcinolone acetonide injectable suspension by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of triazolam by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of trimethoprim by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of trimipramine by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Tucatinib increases the concentration or effect of indinavir by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Consider reducing the dosage of P-gp substrates where minimal concentration changes may lead to serious or life-threatening toxicities. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Ublituximab reduces the efficacy of indinavir through immunosuppressive effects, increasing the risk of infection. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of ulipristal by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of umeclidinium bromide/vilanterol inhaled by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Vilanterol is a CYP3A4 substrate; co-administration with potent CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase systemic exposure. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of upadacitinib by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Use caution if upadacitinib is co-administered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of valbenazine by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Reduce valbenazine dose to 40 mg once daily when co-administered with a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of valsartan by inhibiting OATP1B1 transporters, which may increase valsartan systemic exposure. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of vamorolone by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Reduce vamorolone starting dose to 4 mg/kg/day, not exceeding 200 mg/day if weight >50 kg. Indinavir increases the concentration or effect of vardenafil by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely.
